blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments. Further progress depends on two complementary resources: demonstrations of human behavior that supervise how tasks are performed, and interactive environments in which policies can be rolled out, evaluated, and improved in closed loop. Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors, which first requires identifying which data to scale and how to produce and reuse such data continuously. To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2, comprising 1,589 released metric-scale 3D scans and a collection of 4,230 egocentric recordings of 74 tasks (131 hours). We further show that each capture can be repurposed for robot learning: scenes are converted into physically interactive simulation environments, human motion is retargeted to whole-body robot trajectories, and additional robot behaviors are obtained through virtual teleoperation and automated long-horizon trajectory generation. We propose this joint capture of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection, laying a data foundation for establishing scaling laws over environments and behaviors.
blocks.zh: 最近显示GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1等大型基础模型直接通过视觉观测控制机器人. 然而,在现实环境中,它们仍然在漫长的、富于接触的任务上步履维艰。 进一步的进展取决于两种补充资源:监督如何执行任务的人类行为示范,以及可以将政策推出、评价和在封闭循环中加以改进的互动环境。 语言模型沿着特征鲜明的缩放定律前进;物理AI的相应问题是,在环境和行为方面的能力尺度如何,这首先需要确定哪些数据可以缩放,以及如何持续生成和再利用这些数据。 为了解决这一问题,我们介绍了Ropedia Xperience 2, 其中包括1,589个已发布的公尺级3D扫描和4,230个以自我为中心的74项任务(131小时)的录音。 我们进一步显示,每次捕获都可以重新用于机器人学习:场景被转换为物理交互模拟环境,人类运动被重新瞄准全身机器人轨迹,并通过虚拟远程操作和自动长视轨迹生成获得额外的机器人行为. 我们提议联合捕获环境和行为,作为物理AI数据收集的金本位标准,为制定超越环境和行为的法律奠定数据基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations [ 63 , 50 ] .
On the 42-task RoboDojo benchmark [ 8 ] , GPT-6 Astra attains a reported average success rate of 22.48%, surpassing the 40 public policies in that comparison [ 63 ] , and it reaches 92% on RxR [ 23 ] instruction following and 82% on HM3D [ 45 ] object search [ 16 ] .
These models nevertheless remain far from practical deployment: an evaluation across eight robot configurations reports no success in 11 plug-insertion trials across three platforms and 9 successes in 23 navigation-and-search trials for GPT-6 Astra, while tracking progress across many subtasks remains difficult [ 49 ] .
blocks.zh:
大型地基模型,如GPT-6 Astra和克洛德·菲克5.1最近被显示直接从视觉观测控制机器人[63,50].
在42-任务RoboDojo基准[8]中,GPT-6 Astra取得了22.48%的报称平均成功率,超过了40项公共政策的比较[63],在RxR[23]指令之后达到92%,在HM3D[45]对象搜索[16]上达到82%.
然而,这些模型仍然远远没有实际部署:对8个机器人配置进行的评价报告,3个平台的11个插件插入试验没有成功,GPT-6 Astra的23个导航和搜索试验有9个成功,而追踪许多次级任务的进展情况仍然很困难[49]。

blocks.en:
Enabling large foundation models to control robots reliably over long-horizon, complex tasks in real environments requires two complementary resources: (i) behavior demonstrations from which the models can learn, and (ii) environments in which they can execute tasks and accumulate experience.
Language models have advanced along well-characterized scaling laws relating performance to data, model size, and compute [ 18 ] ; the corresponding question for physical AI is how capability scales with environments and behaviors.
Answering it first requires identifying which environment and behavior data to scale, and how such data can be produced and reused continuously.
blocks.zh:
使大型基础模型能够可靠地控制机器人超过长视距,在现实环境中复杂的任务需要两种互补资源:(一)模型能够学习的行为演示,和(二)它们能够执行任务并积累经验的环境.
语言模型沿着与数据,模型大小和计算相关的性能的特征化的缩放定律前进了[18];物理AI的相应问题是能力尺度如何与环境和行为相适应.
答案首先需要确定哪些环境和行为数据可以扩大规模,以及如何持续地生产和再利用这些数据。

blocks.en:
To address this question, we introduce Ropedia Xperience 2 , a dataset of real environments and behaviors for physical AI.
Ropedia Xperience 2 combines LiDAR scans of real scenes with egocentric recordings of human activity; our registration pipeline can place the corresponding scene geometry, video, camera trajectories, and hand and body motion in a common metric frame.
Registered recordings can support human-to-robot motion retargeting, while scanned scenes can be converted into interactive simulation environments; registration checks and per-scene quality control provide tools for auditing, filtering, and reusing the data.
With Ropedia Xperience 2, we aim to establish a gold standard for next-generation physical AI data collection and to lay the data foundation for scaling laws of physical AI over environments and behaviors.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Ropedia Xperience 2,即物理AI真实环境和行为数据集.
Ropedia Xperience 2 组合 LiDAR用以自我为中心的人类活动记录扫描真实场景;我们的注册管道可以将相应的场景几何,视频,相机轨迹,手和身体运动放在一个共同的度量框中.
注册录音可以支持人对机器人运动重定向,而扫描场景可以转换成交互式模拟环境;注册检查和人均场景质量控制提供了审计,过滤,再用数据的工具.
和罗佩迪亚 Xperience 2,我们的目标是为下一代物理AI的数据收集建立金本位,为物理AI的定律在环境和行为之上的尺度化打下数据基础.

blocks.en:
Ropedia Xperience 2 is collected with a two-stage protocol that requires a single operator and no robot or motion-capture infrastructure on site.
Each scene is first scanned once with a handheld 3D scanner, and its assigned tasks are then recorded with the HOMIE head-mounted recorder, so that one scan provides the spatial context for multiple recordings.
The released scan component contains 1,589 scenes.
The broader collection inventory spans 596 locations and 4,230 task recordings totaling 131 hours.
An automated pipeline produces scene meshes and 3D Gaussian representations, alongside camera trajectories, depth, hand and body motion, and hierarchical language captions.
Ropedia Xperience 2 extends Xperience-10M [ 47 ] , which provides about 10 million egocentric interaction clips totaling 10,000 hours, with metric scene scans and a pipeline for registering egocentric recordings to them.
blocks.zh:
Ropedia Xperience 2是用一个两相协议来收集的,协议要求只有一个操作员,并且现场没有机器人或运动捕捉基础设施.
每个场景首先用手持式3D扫描仪扫描一次,其分配的任务再用HOMIE头载记录器记录,这样一次扫描就可以提供多个录音的空间上下文.
所发布的扫描组件包含有1,589个场景.
更广泛的收集清单涵盖596个地点,4 230个任务记录共131小时。
自动管道可以产生场景介质和3D高斯表现,同时产生相机轨迹,深度,手和身体运动,以及分级语言标题.
Ropedia Xperience 2扩展了Xperience-10M[47],它提供了约1000万个自我中心互动片段,共计10000小时,并配有公制场景扫描以及用于向它们注册自我中心录音的管道.

blocks.en:
To assess the fidelity of the data, we use the scan reconstructions as reference geometry in three benchmarks: depth and geometry estimation, 3D object detection, and spatial reasoning.
These benchmarks evaluate existing models across diverse real-world scenes.
blocks.zh:
为了评估数据的可靠性,我们将扫描重建作为三个基准的参考几何:深度和几何估计、三维物体探测和空间推理。
这些基准评价不同现实世界的现有模式。

blocks.en:
Each capture is further reused to scale both environments and behaviors for robot learning (Figure 2 ).
Here, environments are real spaces with their layouts and object relations, and behaviors comprise the recorded human task executions as well as the robot motions and interactions derived from them.
We demonstrate four routes: • Real-to-sim conversion turns a single scan of a real-world environment into an interactive digital twin that preserves the original layout and appearance, incorporates realistic physical properties, and supports part-level object interaction, yielding reusable environments for policy and control learning. • Human-robot retargeting converts the recorded human behaviors, including long-horizon activities, into robot demonstrations from the estimated body and hand motion, without on-site robot deployment. • Virtual teleoperation lets operators collect robot demonstrations in the converted simulation scenes, without physical robots and with automatic scene resets. • Long-horizon trajectory generation rolls out robots on new multi-step tasks in the converted simulation scenes, chaining navigation and manipulation across subtasks from varied start states and object configurations; more trajectories require only additional compute. Real-to-sim conversion scales environments, while retargeting, virtual teleoperation, and trajectory generation scale robot behaviors.
Capture thus scales with operators rather than robots, and the captured data can be expanded into robot data without further on-site collection.
These routes complement real-robot teleoperation by offering lower-cost paths to training environments and demonstrations at different levels of fidelity.
blocks.zh:
每次捕捉都被进一步再用,以标出对机器人学习的环境和行为(图2).
在这里,环境是具有其布局和对象关系的真实空间,行为构成记录的人类任务处决以及机器人运动和由此而来的互动.
我们演示了四种路线: ——真到真转换 将现实世界环境的单一扫描转换为交互式数字双胞胎,保留了原有的布局和外观,融入了现实的物理属性,支持了部分层次的对象交互,为政策和控制学习创造了可再利用的环境. · 人-机器人重定向 将记录下来的人类行为,包括长视线活动,从估计的身体和手动转换成机器人演示,不进行现场机器人部署. · 虚拟远程操作使操作人员在转换后的模拟场景中收集机器人演示,没有物理机器人,并且有自动的场景重排. • 长视轨迹生成器在转换模拟场景中推出新的多步任务机器人,将不同起步状态和对象配置的子任务连锁导航和操纵;更多的轨迹只需要额外的计算. Real-to-sim转换尺度环境,同时重新瞄准,虚拟远程操作,和轨迹生成尺度机器人行为.
因此,捕获量与操作员而不是机器人相适应,所捕获的数据可以被扩展为机器人数据而无需进一步的现场收集.
这些路线通过提供成本较低的培训环境和不同忠诚程度的示范,补充了实际机器人远程操作。

blocks.en:
Our goal is to capture natural human activity together with the 3D structure of the environment in which it occurs, providing spatial context for understanding how people interact with their surroundings.
Scene collections such as ScanNet++ and DL3DV-10K emphasize multi-view observations of real environments [ 61 , 30 ] , while Ego4D and Nymeria capture egocentric activity and motion [ 17 , 32 ] .
Holi-World organizes human-egocentric experience into grounded learning resources [ 27 ] , and SpatialBench evaluates spatial foundation models across scene domains and input densities [ 42 ] .
UMI further demonstrates portable human-demonstration capture without requiring a robot at the collection site [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是捕捉自然人类活动及其发生的环境的三维结构,提供空间背景,以了解人们如何与周围环境互动。
ScanNet++和DL3DV-10K等场景集强调对真实环境的多视图观测[61,30],而Ego4D和Nymeria则捕捉以自我为中心的活动和运动[17,32].
Holi-World将以人-egocent为中心的经验组织成基于地的学习资源[27],而Space Bench则评价跨场域的空间地基模型和输入密度[42].
UMI进一步演示了便携式人-演示捕捉,而不需要机器人在采集地[10].

blocks.en:
We collect Ropedia Xperience 2 in real, in-use environments, including homes, restaurants, stores, offices, and outdoor sites.
Collection is organized by scene: each scene (Level 1) is assigned a set of tasks (Level 2) before capture (Figure 3 a).
blocks.zh:
我们收集Ropedia Xperience 2 在真实的,在使用环境中,包括家庭,餐馆,商店,办公室,和户外场地.
收集按场景排列:每个场景(一级)在抓取前分配一组任务(二级)(图3 a).

blocks.en:
Capturing environmental geometry and natural activity requires different sensing configurations.
Scene scanning benefits from freely chosen viewpoints to observe high, low, and partially occluded regions, while activity recording requires both hands to remain free and the cameras to follow the operator’s viewpoint.
We therefore use two complementary devices (Table 1 ).
The 3D scanner is a handheld LiDAR device equipped with two fisheye and two wide-angle cameras, allowing the operator to scan the scene from varied viewpoints.
HOMIE is a head-mounted egocentric recorder with four global-shutter fisheye cameras, two facing forward and two facing backward.
The forward pair captures the hands and manipulated objects, while the global shutters avoid rolling-shutter distortion during rapid head motion.
HOMIE also records inertial measurements and four-channel audio.
blocks.zh:
捕捉环境几何和自然活性需要不同的感知配置.
场景扫描从自由选择的观点中获益,可以观察高地、低地和部分被占用的区域,而活动记录则需要双方保持自由,摄像头需要遵循操作员的观点。
因此,我们使用两种补充装置(表1)。
3D扫描仪是一种手持的LiDAR设备,配备了两台鱼眼和两台广角相机,使操作员可以从不同角度扫描现场.
HOMIE是一款以自负为中心头顶的录音机,有四台全球Shutter鱼眼相机,两台面向前,两台面向后.
前对捕捉出手和被操纵的物体,而全球百叶窗则避免了在快速头部运动时被滚动-shutter扭曲.
HOMIE还记录了惯性测量和四相声.

blocks.en:
For each scene, the operator first performs a 3D scan and then wears HOMIE to complete the assigned tasks one by one (Figure 3 ).
The protocol is designed to associate task recordings with a 3D scan of the same scene, linking activity to its physical environment; Section 3.3 describes how they can be spatially registered.
The following subsections describe the scenes and tasks and the capture protocol.

blocks.en: 2.1 Scenes and Tasks
blocks.zh: 2.1 场景和任务

blocks.en:
The collection inventory contains 74 Level 2 tasks, 31 of which take place in work and retail scenes such as restaurants, stores, and offices (Figure 4 a).
By leading verb, the tasks fall into seven actions, which form five categories: pick and place, cleaning, rearrangement, folding, and inspection (Figure 4 b).
Placing or taking out objects (25 tasks), wiping and cleaning (23), and arranging and tidying (18) account for most tasks.
The 4,230 uploaded recordings, each one execution of a task, are concentrated in home scenes: placing, taking out, and folding dominate in bedrooms, and wiping in living rooms and bathrooms (Figure 4 c).
blocks.zh:
收集清单包含74个二级任务,其中31个在工作和零售场景中进行,如餐馆、商店和办公室(图4a)。
通过领跑动词,任务分为7个动作,这7个动作构成5个类别:取出和位置,清洁,重排,折叠和检查(图4b).
放置或取出物体(25项任务)、擦拭和清洗(23项)以及安排和清理(18项)占大多数任务。
上传的4,230个录音,每个执行一个任务,都集中在家庭场景:放置、取出和折叠在卧室中占据主导地位,在起居室和浴室中擦拭(图4c)。

blocks.en: 2.2 Capture Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.2 捕捞议定书

blocks.en:
We standardize collection with a written protocol so that captures are consistent across sites and operators.
It covers scene preparation, 3D scanning, and HOMIE task recording; the latter two are shown in Figure 3 b and c.
blocks.zh:
我们用书面协议使收集工作标准化,以便各个地点和操作者之间能够一致地收集资料。
它覆盖了场景准备,3D扫描,以及HOMIE任务记录;后两者如图3b和c所示.

blocks.en:
The scene must remain static from the start of the 3D scan until task recording begins.
Before capture, we therefore minimize appearance changes and transient content: screens are turned off or set to a static image, lights are turned on and kept constant, bystanders and pets leave the scene, and windows and other transparent surfaces are covered where possible.
blocks.zh:
从3D扫描开始到任务记录开始,场景必须保持静态.
因此,在捕捉之前,我们尽量减少外观变化和瞬间内容:屏幕被关闭或设置为静态图像,灯光被打开并保持恒定,旁观者和宠物离开场景,视可能时会覆盖窗户和其他透明表面.

blocks.en:
Scanning aims for complete coverage with redundant views.
The operator walks slowly through the scene, traversing each route in both directions, scans occluded and detailed regions at close range, and sweeps the device vertically to add high and low viewpoints.
blocks.zh:
扫描旨在以冗余视图进行完整覆盖.
接线员缓慢地走入场景,以双向横穿每条路由,近距离扫描被渗透和详细区域,并垂直地扫描设备以添加高低视角.

blocks.en:
Task recording aims to capture each activity completely and naturally.
Before each recording, the operator checks that the device is secure and that no lens is obstructed.
Recording begins before the task starts and ends after it is completed, so that each recording contains the entire activity.
blocks.zh:
任务记录旨在完全和自然地记录每一项活动。

blocks.en: 3 Processing and Annotation
blocks.zh: 3 处理和说明

blocks.en:
For each scene, the 3D scan provides a static, metric 3D reconstruction (Section 3.1 ).
The HOMIE processing pipeline can turn task recordings into synchronized video, a device trajectory, and hand, body, and activity annotations (Section 3.2 ).
The pipeline can register a recording’s device trajectory and estimated hand and body motion to the reconstruction of the corresponding scene (Section 3.3 ).
Table 2 lists the resulting assets and their provenance, and Figure 5 shows example recordings registered into their scenes.
blocks.zh:
对于每个场景,3D扫描提供了静态的,公制的3D重建(第3.1节.
HOMIE处理管道可将任务录音转换成同步视频、设备轨迹、手、身体和活动说明(第3.2节)。
管道可以记录录音装置的轨迹和估计手和身体动向,以便重建相应的场景(第3.3节)。
表2列出了由此产生的资产及其出处,图5显示了记录在现场的例子。

blocks.en: 3.1 3D Scan Processing
blocks.zh: 3.1 三维扫描处理

blocks.en:
The 3D scan exports comprise fisheye images with their camera poses and a sparse point model in COLMAP format [ 48 ] , a triangle mesh, and a 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) model [ 20 ] ; available assets depend on the export.
These assets share one coordinate frame, which we call the scene frame ; because the geometry is measured by LiDAR, the scene frame is metric.
The posed images and the mesh serve as the reference for registering the task recordings of the scene (Section 3.3 ), and the 3DGS model renders the scene from arbitrary viewpoints, such as the recorded HOMIE camera poses (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh:
3D扫描输出包括有相机外观的鱼眼图像和COLMAP格式的稀有点模型[48],三角网格,和3D高斯平板(3DGS)模型[20];可用资产取决于出口.
这些资产共享一个坐标帧,我们称之为场景帧;由于几何由LiDAR测量,场景帧是度量的.
所展示的图像和网格作为记录现场任务录音的参考(第3.3节),3DGS模型使场景从任意的角度出发,例如录制的HOMIE相机外观(图5).

blocks.en: 3.2 HOMIE  Processing
blocks.zh: 3.2 HOMIE 处理

blocks.en: We use the same automated pipeline to process HOMIE recordings.
blocks.zh: 我们用同样的自动管道 处理HOMIE的录音。

blocks.en:
The four cameras are hardware-synchronized, and all sensor samples are timestamped by the device clock.
We place the four videos on a common 30 fps frame index and link the IMU and audio samples to it by timestamp.
Each device is calibrated before capture, and every recording stores the intrinsics of the four fisheye cameras and their extrinsics relative to the IMU (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh:
四个相机是硬件同步的,所有的传感器样本都由设备时钟进行时间标记.
我们把这四段视频放入30英尺帧索引上 用时间戳把IMU和音频样本连接起来
每个设备在被捕获前都要校正,每个记录都存储了四个鱼眼相机的内在内容及其相对于IMU(附录B.1 .

blocks.en:
The two forward-facing views are rectified into a pinhole stereo pair, on which SLAM, depth, and hand estimation operate.
SLAM estimates a 6-DoF device pose for every frame and a sparse landmark map in a gravity-aligned metric frame whose origin is the head position at the first frame.
A stereo module additionally estimates metric depth with per-pixel confidence.
blocks.zh:
两种前向观点被修正成针孔立体对,SALM,深度,和手相相相相相推算.
SLAM估计每个帧都有一个6-DoF装置,并用重力相通的度量框架绘制出一张稀有地标地标地图,其出处是第一帧的头部位置.
一个立体模块附加了每像素置信度的度量深度估计.

blocks.en:
Hands are represented with MANO [ 46 ] and estimated with our in-house annotation pipeline.
The pipeline fits MANO to hand keypoints recovered from the calibrated stereo views, using cross-view reprojection consistency to refine the estimates.
The output is 21 joints per hand in the stereo-left camera frame.
When a hand is outside the view or occluded, no estimate is produced for that frame.
blocks.zh:
手用MANO[46]表示 手用我们内部的注解管道估计
管道适合MANO手取从校正立体视图中取出的关键点,使用交叉视图再投影一致性来细化估算.
输出为立体左相机相框中每手有21个关节.
当一只手在外观或被围住时,没有为该帧产生估计值.

blocks.en:
We estimate the wearer’s full-body motion with EgoAllo [ 62 ] , using the SLAM-derived head trajectory as conditioning and our hand estimates as guidance.
The motion is represented with SMPL-H [ 46 ] , with body shape held constant within each recording.
The output comprises 52 body and finger joints at 30 Hz in the recording’s SLAM frame.
The estimated motion is constrained by the observed head and hands, while unobserved body parts, particularly the legs, are inferred using the learned motion prior.
blocks.zh:
我们估计佩戴者的全身运动与EgoAllo[62],
运动用SMPL-H[46]代表,每次录音中身体形状保持不变.
产出包括52个身体和手指关节,位于录制的SLAM框架30赫兹.
估计的运动受到被观察到的头和手的制约,而未被观察到的身体部位,特别是腿部,则使用事先学会的运动来推断.

blocks.en:
We use a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical activity annotations from the recordings.
The annotations describe the recorded activity at three temporal scales.
For the full recording, they summarize the main task and provide an overall activity description.
Within the recording, they identify sub-tasks and actions with associated time intervals.
For each sampled frame, they describe visible objects and their states, the state of each hand, and ongoing hand–object interactions.
All annotations are associated with the video timeline.
The temporally localized actions are distinct from the task-level action categories in Section 2.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个大型的多式模型,从录音中生成分级活性说明.
说明以三个时间尺度描述记录的活动。
为全面记录,它们总结了主要任务,并提供了总体活动描述.
在记录中,他们确定了分任务和相关时间间隔的行动。
对于每个抽样框架,它们描述了可见物体及其状态、每只手的状态以及正在进行的手-物体相互作用。
所有说明都与视频时间表有关.
按时间划分的行动不同于第2.1节的任务级行动类别。

blocks.en: Registration can then transform the device trajectory and estimated hand and body poses into the scene frame (Section 3.3 ), while the activity annotations remain associated with their corresponding timestamps.
blocks.zh: 然后,登记可以将设备轨迹和估计的手和身体摆入场景框架(第3.3节),而活动说明仍与其相应的时间戳相联。

blocks.en: 3.3 Scan–HOMIE  Registration
blocks.zh: 3.3 扫描-homie 登记

blocks.en:
The scan reconstruction and each HOMIE recording are expressed in separate coordinate frames.
To place human activity in its spatial context, we register the recording’s device trajectory and estimated hand and body motion to the scene frame.
As illustrated in Figure 5 , this brings the egocentric observations, estimated motion, and scene geometry into a shared spatial reference.
Connecting egocentric activity to scene geometry is also central to EPIC Fields, which augments activity videos with reconstructed camera information [ 53 ] .
blocks.zh:
扫描重建与每个HOMIE记录用单独的坐标框表示.
为了将人类活动置于其空间背景中,我们记录了录音设备的轨迹以及估计的手和身体运动情况。
如图5所示,这把以自我为中心的观测、估计运动和场地几何学纳入一个共享的空间参考。
连接以自我为中心的活动与场景几何也是EPIC场景的核心,它用重建相机信息来增强活动视频[53].

blocks.en:
We localize stereo-left frames in the scan using SIFT [ 31 ] matching, RANSAC [ 15 ] , and PnP against scan image keypoints lifted onto the mesh, then fit the recording-to-scene transform by robust Umeyama alignment [ 54 ] of the corresponding camera centers.
The transform allows a small scale correction when supported by the trajectory and validation; otherwise, it is rigid.
Held-out frames, IMU gravity consistency, and an ICP [ 4 ] check of stereo depth against the mesh are used to assess the alignment and assign PASS, WEAK, or FAIL labels (Appendix B.3 ).
A single transform cannot correct local SLAM drift within a recording.
blocks.zh:
在扫描中定位立体左相框 使用SIFT[31]匹配,RANSAC [15],以及PnP对扫描图像键点 提升到网格上,然后通过强力的Umeyama对接[54] 相应相机中心来适应记录到场面的变换.
在轨迹和验证的支撑下,变换可以进行小规模的校正;否则,变换为刚性.
Hold-out frames,IMU重力一致性,以及比较方案[4]对照网格对立体深度的检查,用于评估对齐并指定PASS,WEAK或FAIL标签(附录B.3).
一个单一的变换无法在记录中纠正本地的 SLAM 漂移.

blocks.en: 5 Applications
blocks.zh: 5 申请

blocks.en:
The applications comprise three benchmarks (depth and geometry, 3D object detection, and spatial intelligence) and downstream demonstrations.
All three benchmarks use the same 20 scanned scenes, listed in Appendix D.1 .

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmarking Existing Models
blocks.zh: 5.1 现有模式的基准

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Depth and Geometry
blocks.zh: 5.1.1 深度和几何

blocks.en:
Understanding human activity in a scene requires recovering the surrounding geometry and the observer’s motion.
We evaluate how well existing models recover depth, camera trajectories, and scene surfaces from multi-view images, and how their performance changes with the number of input views.
blocks.zh:
了解场景中的人类活动需要恢复周围几何和观察者的动作.
我们评价现有模型如何从多视图图像中恢复深度、相机轨迹和场景表面,以及其性能如何随着输入视图的数量而变化。

blocks.en: The comparison follows SpatialBench [ 42 ] , with models grouped into its optimization-based, end-to-end feed-forward, online, chunk-wise, SLAM-based, and test-time-training categories (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 比较采用Space Bench [42],模型分为基于优化的、端到端的、在线的、分块的、基于SLAM的以及测试时间的培训类别(表4)。

blocks.en:
All models are evaluated on the same 20 scenes under Sparse (5 frames), Medium (11–100 frames), and Dense (335–500 frames) settings.
Table 4 (a) reports depth AbsRel, RMSE, and δ 1.03 \delta_{1.03} ; panel (b) reports pose AUC@ 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} , trajectory ATE, Chamfer distance (CD), and surface F-score at 5 cm.
The scan reconstructions provide the reference geometry and camera poses.
Depth is median-scaled per scene, so its scores evaluate scale-normalized depth quality.
Frame selection, alignment, and metric definitions are detailed in Appendix D.2 .
blocks.zh:
所有模型在Sparse(5帧),Medium(11-100帧)和Dense(335-500帧)设置下在同一20个场景上进行评估.
表4 (a) 报告深度:AbsRel、RMSE和 ^ 1.03\delta_{1.03};小组 (b) 报告为AUC@ 30∘30Circ}、轨迹:ATE、Chamfer距离(CD)和地表:F分数为5厘米。
扫描重建提供了参考几何和相机的外观.
深度为每个场景的中位尺度,因此其分数评价了尺度-正态深度质量.
框架选择、调整和计量定义详见附录D.2。

blocks.en:
No single model leads across all metrics. π 3 \pi^{3} achieves the lowest trajectory ATE and the highest surface F-score across all three input settings, while DA3-Giant achieves the highest pose AUC in the Medium and Dense settings.
More input views do not consistently improve performance: CUT3R’s pose AUC decreases from 0.4103 to 0.0625 between Sparse and Dense, whereas DA3-Giant’s increases from 0.7540 to 0.8074.
Dense inputs also expose memory limitations, with DUSt3R and MASt3R unable to complete evaluation.
These results highlight differences in geometric accuracy and scalability that are not captured by depth scores alone.
blocks.zh:
没有一个单一的模型会贯穿所有指标。 ^ 3\pi^{3}在所有三种输入设置中实现最低轨迹ATE和最高地表F分,而DA3-Giant则在中和地心设置中实现最高的AUC.
更多的输入视图无法持续改善绩效: CUT3R的AUC在Sparse和Dense之间从0.4103降至0.0625,而DA3-Giant则从0.7540增至0.8074。
深思熟虑的投入也暴露出内存限制,DUST3R和MAST3R无法完成评价.
这些结果凸显出几何精确度和可伸缩性的差异,这些差异并非仅由深度分数来捕捉.

blocks.en: 5.1.2 3D Object Detection
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 三维 对象检测

blocks.en: Annotators manually label the 20 evaluation scenes for this benchmark, marking the category and 3D box of each object in the scene frame; these labels are the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 注释者手动给这个基准的20个评价场景贴上标签,标出场景框中每个物体的类别和3D框;这些标签是地上真实的.

blocks.en:
The comparison covers three groups (Table 5 ): end-to-end models that predict boxes from images or point clouds (SpatialLM [ 34 ] , LLaVA-3D [ 64 ] , SceneScript [ 2 ] , Map-Det3D [ 60 ] ), language fields embedded in a 3DGS (M3 [ 67 ] , LangSplat [ 44 ] ), and Boxer [ 13 ] , which lifts open-vocabulary 2D detections to 3D boxes.
Each method is queried with the object categories present in the scene.
blocks.zh:
比较范围包括三组(表5):从图像或点云预测出盒的端到端模型(SpatialLM [34],LLaVA-3D [64],SceneScript [2],Map-Det3D [60]),嵌入于3DGS(M3 [67],LangSplatz [44]))中的语言字段;和Boxer [13],将可打开-vocabulary 2D检测到3D盒.
每种方法都与场景中存在的对象类别被询问.

blocks.en:
AP 25 and AP 50 are average precision at 3D IoU thresholds of 0.25 and 0.5; mIoU@0.25 is the mean 3D IoU of predictions matched to a reference box at IoU 0.25.

blocks.en: 5.2 Demonstrations

blocks.en:
Generalist robot policies learn visuomotor control from diverse demonstrations, as explored by RT-1 and RT-2 [ 7 , 6 ] ; Open X-Embodiment provides a cross-robot data collection for such learning [ 37 ] .
OpenVLA [ 22 ] and the π 0 \pi_{0} and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} models [ 5 , 43 ] further study adapting vision-language priors to robot control and generalization.
blocks.zh:

OpenVLA [22]和"0\pi_{0]"和"0.5\pi_{0.5"模型[5,43]进一步研究将视觉语前作适应机器人控制和通化.

blocks.en:
The demonstrations use metric, gravity-aligned scene geometry and the pipeline’s ability to register HOMIE recordings to the corresponding scenes.
Real-to-Sim turns a scene into a simulator scene, in which an operator can teleoperate a robot live (virtual teleoperation) and a robot can run new multi-step tasks (long-horizon generation); retargeting drives a robot with recorded human motion.
Each demonstration lists its input, output, and the checks a valid result must pass.

每个演示都列出其输入,输出,检查结果必须有效.

blocks.en: 5.2.1 Real-to-Sim

Neural scene representations such as NeRF [ 35 ] support novel-view rendering, while Habitat 2.0 and BEHAVIOR-1K provide environments for physics-based robot interaction [ 51 , 26 ] .
RialTo explores constructing digital twins from real-world captures to improve robot policies [ 52 ] .

blocks.en:
Input: a captured scene with metric geometry and appearance. Output: a simulator scene and an agent or camera rollout. Checks: scale, gravity alignment, collision geometry, and visual correspondence.
Figure 8 (a) shows a converted scene of 217 separate objects.
Because the scene is built in the scan’s frame, any camera can render both the simulator scene and the 3DGS, so the two can be compared view by view without a separate registration step; the zoom-ins A and B match in layout, object extent, and appearance.
Panel (b) repeats the comparison for a scene built from the captured images alone.
Without metric geometry, that scene changes object colours, sizes, and positions, and the boxes of the four matched objects drift from those in the 3DGS.
The boxes measure consistency with the 3DGS rather than accuracy against an independent ground truth.
blocks.zh:
输入:一个被俘的场景,带有度量几何和外观. 输出:模拟场景和代理或相机推出. 检查:尺度,重力对接,相撞几何,和相视相通.
图8 (a)显示217个独立物体的转换场景。
由于场景是在扫描的构架中构建的,任何相机都可以同时渲染出模拟场景和3DGS,因此可以将两者通过视图比较而无需单独注册步骤;缩放A和B在布局,对象范围,外观上相匹配.
(b) 小组重复对仅从捕获的图像所建的场景进行比较。
没有度量几何,这个场景会改变物体的颜色,大小和位置,四个匹配物体的框会从3DGS中漂移出.
方框衡量与3DGS的一致性,而不是对照独立的地面真理的准确性。

blocks.en: 5.2.2 Human-Robot Retargeting
blocks.zh: 5.2.2 人类机器人重新瞄准目标

blocks.en:
Input: a HOMIE recording with body and hand motion registered to its scanned scene. Output: base, whole-body, and dexterous-hand joint trajectories of a wheeled humanoid, replayed in the scene’s Gaussian reconstruction. Checks: joint velocity and torque within 90% of their limits, ZMP inside the support polygon, no scene or self-collision, and head and fingertip tracking error.
Recordings are slowed down 2 × \times before retargeting.
Figure 9 shows four full recordings in one scene, 10.3 min of motion in total.
The robot drives 96 m with its base, moving in 35–41% of the frames, while its hands track the operator’s fingertips with median errors of 0.40–0.55 cm and 95th-percentile errors below 2 cm.
Every frame passes every check: peak joint speed and torque reach 90% and 89% of their limits, and the ZMP stays at least 0.46 cm inside the support polygon.
blocks.zh:
输入:一个HOMIE记录,其扫描场景记录有身体和手动。 输出:一个轮式人造物的基部,全身,和德克西特-手相接的轨迹,在现场高斯重建中被重放. 检查:在90%的限度内进行联合速度和扭矩,ZMP在支持多边形内,没有场景或自缩,以及头和指尖跟踪出错.
记录在重定向前会减慢2×x\时间.
图9显示一个场景中的4个完整录音,总共10.3分动作.
机器人用其底座驱动96米,在35-41%的相框中移动,而手则以0.40–0.55厘米的中位误差和2厘米以下的95分误差来追踪操作者的指尖.
每帧都通过每一次检查:峰联速度和扭矩达到其极限的90%和89%,ZMP至少会停留在支持的多边形内0.46厘米.

blocks.en: 5.2.3 Virtual Teleoperation
blocks.zh: 5.2.3 虚拟电信业务

blocks.en:
Input: the simulator scene from Real-to-Sim, built from the scan’s mesh and 3DGS, and an operator teleoperating live. Output: a simulated robot under live teleoperation in that scene, and its interaction rollouts. Checks: end-effector tracking of the operator’s commands, scene collisions, and joint limits.
Figure 10 shows an operator wearing a head-mounted display and hand input devices controlling a simulated humanoid in a converted kitchen scene.
The robot grasps a kettle by its handle, lifts it from the counter, moves it over the cooktop, and places it down before releasing the handle.
The robot-camera and external-camera views show the same interaction from complementary viewpoints.
The resulting rollout contains both robot motion and a change in the object’s state, demonstrating that the scanned environment can support the collection of new interactive robot demonstrations.
The scene can be restored in simulation for another collection, without manually resetting a physical setup.
blocks.zh:
输入:来自Real-to-Sim的模拟场景,由扫描的网格和3DGS所建,以及一个操作员远程操作直播. 输出:一个模拟机器人在现场远程操作下在该场景下, 及其相互作用的展开. 检查:终端效应跟踪操作员的命令,场景相撞,以及联想限制.
图10显示一个操作员在经过改造的厨房场景中佩戴了头挂显示和手接输入装置,控制了模拟人像.
机器人用手柄抓住一壶,从柜台上抬起,移动到锅顶上,放出手柄前放倒.
机器人-相机和外相机的视角从互补的角度显示相同的相互作用.
由此而来推出的作品既包含机器人运动,也包含物体状态的变化,表明被扫描的环境可以支持收集新的交互式机器人演示.
场景可以在模拟另一个收藏时被恢复,而无需手动重设物理设置.

Left: an example rollout (rendered with a chase camera), with a frame as each subtask completes, the time since the start, and the steps that subtask’s policy program logged; the last cell gives the results of the 30 held-out rollouts per subtask and for the full task. Right: the scene’s top-down plan with the example base path coloured by subtask, the places where its subtasks end, and the start poses of the 30 held-out rollouts.

blocks.en: 5.2.4 Long-Horizon Trajectory Generation
blocks.zh: 5.2.4 长视线轨迹生成

blocks.en:
SayCan and PaLM-E explore language-conditioned task planning [ 1 , 14 ] , while Code as Policies generates robot policy programs from language [ 28 ] .
MimicGen studies expanding demonstration datasets by adapting human demonstrations to new contexts [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh:
SayCan和PALM-E探索语言条件任务规划[1,14],而"代码作为政策"则从语言生成机器人政策程序[28].
MimicGen研究通过使人类演示适应新的环境来扩展演示数据集 [33].

blocks.en:
Input: an object-level simulator scene from Real-to-Sim, a robot model, and a task given as a sequence of subtasks. Output: robot trajectories that chain navigation and manipulation through every subtask, from varied initial robot and object poses. Checks: per-subtask and full-task success from the simulator’s object states, task rules on the objects (nothing tipped or dropped, appliances and doors left as each subtask requires), trajectory duration, and generation yield and time per valid trajectory.
We generate trajectories for one eight-subtask task in a converted home environment: a wheeled dual-arm robot picks up a mug from the kitchen counter, opens the microwave, puts the mug inside, closes the door to heat it, takes it out, closes the microwave again, pushes the closed bedroom door open, and sets the mug on the bedside table (Figure 11 ).
Each subtask is a policy program that acts through a whole-body controller and observes objects only through perception, not through the simulator state; the eight run in one continuous rollout without resets.
From 30 held-out start states, each with its own robot and mug pose, all 30 rollouts complete all eight subtasks without breaking a task rule.
A trajectory lasts 3,869–4,255 control steps at 30 Hz (2.2 min on average) and takes 10–16 min of wall-clock time on one simulation worker, so further trajectories cost only compute.
blocks.zh:
输入:来自Real-to-Sim的物体级模拟器场景,机器人模型,以及作为子任务序列而赋予的任务. 输出:通过每个子任务,从不同的初始机器人和物体的姿势,将导航和操纵连锁起来的机器人轨迹. 检查: 模拟器对象状态下的每个子任务和全部任务成功率, 对象的任务规则( 无提示或丢弃, 按每个子任务要求留下的电器和门), 轨迹持续时间, 以及每个有效轨道的生成率和时间 。
我们在改造后的家庭环境中为一个8个子任务产生轨迹:一个轮式双臂机器人从厨房柜台取出一个杯子,打开微波炉,把杯子放进去,把门关上取暖,取出,再把微波炉关上,把封闭的卧室门推开,把杯子放入床位上(图11).
每个子任务是一个政策程序,它通过一个全身控制器来操作,并且只通过感知来观察对象,而不是通过模拟状态来观察;8运行在一个连续的展开中而无需重置.
从30个被搁置的开始状态,每个都有自己的机器人和杯子相姿势,所有30个推出都完成所有8个子任务而未违反任务规则.
轨迹会持续到30赫兹(平均2.2分)的3,869–4,255个控制步骤,而且一个模拟工需要10–16分的墙上小时时间,因此进一步的轨迹成本只能计算出.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en:
The released scan component is dominated by home interiors and includes Reuse scans with partial coverage or other reconstruction defects.
Release grades incorporate policy overrides and resolution of conflicting QC labels; they should not be interpreted as a uniform visual or geometric validation of all retained scans.
Separate scans may depict the same physical space, and the collection-site inventory is not a verified site census of the released subset.
blocks.zh:
所发布的扫描组件以家用内部为主,并包括有部分覆盖或其他重建缺陷的再用扫描.
发布分级包含政策超标并解决了相冲突的QC标签;它们不应被解释为对所有保留扫描的统一视觉或几何验证.
单独扫描可能描绘出同样的物理空间,而收集地点的清点并非对释放子集进行核实的现场普查.

blocks.en:
The recording count and duration describe the collection inventory.
Hand and body motion are estimated rather than motion-capture ground truth, unobserved body parts are inferred, and activity captions are model-generated.
A single recording-to-scene transform cannot correct local SLAM drift.
blocks.zh:
记录的清点和持续时间说明了收集清单。
手和身体运动是估计的,而不是运动抓取地面的真理,推断出未观察的身体部分,活动标题是模型生成的.
单一记录到场面的变换无法校正本地的 SLAM漂移.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
Ropedia Xperience 2 extends Xperience-10M’s focus on human behavior with metric scans of real environments and a pipeline for placing egocentric recordings and estimated motion in a shared scene frame.
Its two-stage collection protocol captures environments and behaviors without requiring robots on site.
The resulting scene representations support three benchmarks for evaluating existing models, while real-to-sim conversion, human-robot retargeting, virtual teleoperation, and long-horizon trajectory generation demonstrate how captured scenes and recordings can be reused to produce simulation environments and robot trajectories.
This reuse allows a real capture to support both the study of observed human activity and the generation of further robot experience.
We propose joint capture, spatial registration, and reuse of environments and behaviors as a gold standard for physical AI data collection.
These resources provide a data foundation for studying scaling laws that relate physical AI capability to the scale and diversity of environments and behaviors.
blocks.zh:
Ropedia Xperience 2 扩展了Xperience-10M对人行为的关注,对真实环境进行了度量扫描,并用管道将自负心的录音和估计运动放入共享场景框架.
它的两阶段收集协议可以捕捉环境和行为,而不需要机器人在现场.
由此产生的场景表现支持了评价现有模型的三项基准,而实相转换,人-机器人重定向,虚拟远程操作,以及长视轨迹生成则证明了如何可以被捕获的场景和录音被再用来产生模拟环境和机器人轨迹.
这种再利用可以实现真正的捕捉,既能支持被观测到的人类活性的研究,又能产生更多的机器人体验.
我们提议联合采集、空间登记和重新利用环境和行为,作为实际人工智能数据收集的黄金标准。
这些资源为研究将物理AI能力与环境和行为的规模和多样性相联系的缩放法提供了一个数据基础.

blocks.en: B.2 Pose and Language Annotation

blocks.en:
For each hand and frame, our in-house annotation pipeline provides 21 3D joints, the wrist pose, the finger-joint rotations, and the MANO shape coefficients, all in the rectified stereo-left camera frame.
Frames in which a hand is not estimated are marked as missing.
blocks.zh:
对于每个手和相框,我们内部的注音管提供了21个3D关节,手腕姿势,指相接旋转,和MANO形状系数,都位于修正后立体左相机相框.
未估算出手的框被标记为缺失 。

blocks.en:
The body estimate comprises 52 SMPL-H joints covering the body and fingers, the local joint rotations, the root and head poses in the SLAM world frame, shape coefficients that are constant over the recording, and soft contact scores.
Whenever a hand is observed, the wrist and finger joints of the body agree with its MANO estimate.
blocks.zh:

每当看到一只手,身体的手腕和指关节都与其MANO估计一致.

blocks.en:
We use a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical language annotations for each recording.
These annotations summarize the overall task, identify temporally localized sub-tasks and actions, and describe objects, hand states, and hand–object interactions.
blocks.zh:
我们使用一个大型的多式模型来为每次录音生成分级语言说明.
这些说明概括了总体任务,确定了时间定位的子任务和行动,并描述了对象、手态和手-对象相互作用。

blocks.en: B.3 Scene–Activity Registration
blocks.zh: B.3 场景 - 活动登记

blocks.en:
Registration needs the scan images with their COLMAP camera model and the mesh, and from HOMIE the SLAM trajectory, the rectified stereo-left video with its intrinsics, and the calibration.
Scans exported only as 3DGS or point clouds cannot be registered.
The recording–scan pairs come from the collection metadata (Section 2.2 ), and the initialization below also verifies that both show the same place.
blocks.zh:
注册需要扫描图像,包括他们的COLMAP相机模型和网格,从HOMIE中需要SLAM轨迹,修正后带有内在的立体左向视频,以及校正.
仅导出为 3DGS 或点云的扫描无法注册 。
记录-扫描对来自收集元数据(第2.2节),下面的初始化也证明两者都显示同一位置。

blocks.en:
We select well-textured stereo-left frames spread over the recording and match each against the scan images with SIFT features, scoring candidate images by the inliers of a fundamental matrix estimated with RANSAC.
Matched scan keypoints are lifted to 3D by intersecting their camera rays with the mesh, and PnP gives the pose of the HOMIE camera in the scene frame.
Initialization succeeds when several frames yield a consistent transform, and the initial rotation is the rotation average of their PnP poses.
blocks.zh:
我们选择了分布在录音上的精致文字的立体左相框,并且将每个相匹配于具有SIFT特性的扫描图像,用RANSAC估计的基本矩阵的插座来评分候选图像.
相匹配的扫描键点通过相机射线与网格相接被提升到3D,而PnP给出了场景相框中HOMIE相机的姿势.
当多个帧产生一致的变换时初始化成功,初始旋转是它们的PnP所构成的旋转平均值.

blocks.en:
About 200 query frames, evenly spaced along the recording, are localized by PnP against scan images retrieved near the pose predicted by the current transform, and localization is repeated once with the fitted transform. 𝐒 \mathbf{S} is fit by robust Umeyama alignment between the SLAM camera centers and the PnP camera centers, preferring frames with many PnP inliers.
The fit uses even frames, and odd frames give the held-out error.
The scale of 𝐒 \mathbf{S} absorbs small discrepancies between the two metric reconstructions.
A similarity transform is chosen only when the trajectory spans at least 2.5 m and its held-out error is clearly lower than that of a rigid transform; otherwise 𝐒 \mathbf{S} is rigid.
As a drift indicator, the two halves of the recording are also fit separately and compared.
blocks.zh:
大约200个查询框,沿录音平平相距,由PnP对取自于当前变换所预想的姿势相近的扫描图像进行本地化处理,本地化在被安装的变换后重复一次. S \ mathbf{S} 通过在 SLAM相机中心和 PnP相机中心之间强力的 Umeyama 相机配对,
适配使用偶相框,奇相框给出了被搁置出错.
S\ mathbf{S} 的缩放吸收了两个度量重建之间的小差异 。
只有当轨迹跨度至少为2.5米,且其悬浮出错明显低于刚性变换时,才会选择相似性变换;否则S\mathbf{S}是刚性的.
作为漂移指标,记录的两分之一也分别相配并作比较.

blocks.en:
We compare the gravity direction from the HOMIE IMU with the floor normal of the scan mesh, measure the height of the SMPL-H toe joints above the floor, and compare the stereo depth with the scan: its scale relative to the SLAM landmarks, the fraction of depth points that lie on the mesh and their residual, and the displacement of an ICP refinement started from 𝐒 \mathbf{S} .
A registration is labeled FAIL if initialization finds no consistent transform, fewer than eight frames are localized, the held-out error has a 90th percentile above 30 cm, or ICP moves the registration by more than 30 cm; the last case indicates that the images agree but the geometry does not, as in an identical-looking neighboring unit.
Otherwise it is labeled PASS when the held-out error has a median of at most 5 cm and a 90th percentile of at most 12 cm, the gravity deviation is at most 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} , and ICP moves the registration by at most 10 cm and 2 ∘ 2^{\circ} , and WEAK when any of these criteria is missed.
The toe height is reported but does not affect the label.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了HOMIE IMU的重力方向与扫描网的地平面正常,测量了地平上方的SMPL-H脚趾关节的高度,并将立体深度与扫描进行对比:相对于SLAM地平线的尺度,位于网格上及其残存的深度点的分量,以及由S\mathbf{S}开始的比较方案改进的去向.
如果初始化没有发现一致的变换,不到8个帧被本地化,被搁置出错的百分位数在30厘米以上,或者ICP移动了30厘米以上,则注册被贴上FAIL的标签;最后一个案例表明图像同意,但几何并不一致,就像一个相貌相同的相邻单位.

blocks.en:
Recordings performed in place, with a trajectory span below about 2 m, do not constrain scale and are registered rigidly.
Localization succeeds less often for frames that look down at the hands or a tabletop, because these views differ strongly from the scanner’s viewpoints.
A single transform cannot correct local SLAM drift, which affects long recordings; per-segment correction is left to future work.

blocks.en: B.4 Scene QC and Release Decisions
blocks.zh: B.4 现场质量控制和释放决定

blocks.en:
The QC checklist has five checks: (1) preparation, whether the scene was prepared as required by the protocol; (2) door state; (3) full room, whether the whole room is covered; (4) gaps and corners; and (5) occluded regions and views.
QC notes identify defects such as moving people, door motion, invalid traversal, double imaging, failed reconstruction, and partial coverage.
Release grades combine the recorded QC result with the release policy below; the checklist is not a claim that every retained scan passes every check.
blocks.zh:
QC核对表有5个检查: (1)准备,场景是否按照协议的要求准备; (2)门状态; (3)全室,整个房间是否覆盖; (4)空隙和角; (5)被占用的区域和观点.
QC笔记识别出移动人,出门运动等缺陷,道道道无效,双成像,重建失败,部分覆盖.
发布分级结合了所记录的QC结果和下面的发布政策;清单并不是声称每个保留扫描都通过每个检查.

blocks.en:
The approved release retains only completed uploads assigned Perfect, Usable, or Reuse, counting each work once.
Previous Delete decisions in Living room, Multi-room, Office, Meeting room, Store, Restaurant, Outdoor corridor, and Urban street are reassigned to Reuse.
Completed scans without an explicit QC result are retained as Usable only in Living room, Multi-room, Outdoor corridor, Urban street, and Parking lot.
This rule accounts for 7 scans in the QC registry and 84 additional scans documented in the release supplement.
For conflicting recorded grades, the release takes the best in the order Perfect, Usable, Reuse, Delete; 33 retained scans use this rule.
Delete decisions remaining after these rules are outside the release.
The retained-grade percentages use Perfect + Usable + Reuse (1,589); the retained-versus-Delete comparison uses that sum plus Delete (1,610).
Ungraded and incomplete works are outside both denominators.

先前在客厅、多间房、办公室、会议室、商店、餐馆、户外走廊和城市街道的删除决定重新分配给再使用。
